name: Aiden Silverant
bio:
Aiden Silverant is highly renowned for his exceptional skill in creating stunning tattoos with an emphasis on realism and black & gray styles. As the founder and lead artist at Silverant Tattoo in Hanoi, Vietnam, he maintains the highest standard of professionalism, ensuring that each client's experience is not only satisfying in terms of aesthetic results but also in the seamless process of their tattoo journey. His commitment to excellence has established him as a preeminent figure in the local tattoo community.

Current location: Hanoi, Vietnam
